description: Feux de forêt is a dataset listed in Données Québec open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ministère des Ressources naturelles et des Forêts. Le lien: Accéder au répertoire de données est disponible à la section Fiches descriptives du jeu de données; Informations complémentaires. La cartographie des feux de forêt présente les incendies forestiers ayant eu lieu principalement sur le territoire du Québec méridional, soit la zone située au sud de la limite territoriale des forêts attribuables. Coverage: Québec. The portal files it under the publisher Ministère des Ressources naturelles et des Forêts. Its tags are Brulis, Brulis partiel, Brulis total, Couche annuelle, DIF. It offers 18 resource(s) in FGDB, GPKG, HTML, PDF, SHP. The portal shows 2026-06-19 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Attribution (CC-BY 4.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-quebec-portal.
